use std::{env, fs, io::{self, Write}, process::Command, thread, time::Duration};
#[cfg(unix)]
use std::process::Stdio;

fn main() {
    let args = env::args().skip(1).collect::<Vec<_>>();
    match args.first().map(String::as_str) {
        #[cfg(windows)]
        Some("--owned-exceptions") => exception_fixture::run(&args[1]),
        #[cfg(windows)]
        Some("--owned-tls-exceptions") => exception_fixture::verify_tls(),
        #[cfg(windows)]
        Some("--owned-dll-exceptions") => exception_fixture::verify_dll(&args[1]),
        Some("--observe-launch") => {
            // First-party launch-parity control: inputs are bounded by the
            // admitted test packet; no helper, network or game is invoked.
            fs::write("launch-arguments", format!("{:?}", &args[1..])).unwrap();
            let mut environment = env::vars_os().collect::<Vec<_>>();
            environment.sort();
            fs::write("launch-environment", format!("{environment:?}")).unwrap();
            fs::write("launch-directory", format!("{:?}", env::current_dir().unwrap())).unwrap();
        }
        Some("extractdvd") => owned_conversion(&args),
        Some("extractcd") => owned_psx_conversion(&args),
        Some("--owned-preparation") => owned_preparation(&args),
        Some("--owned-builder-fixture") => {
            let mode = fs::read_to_string("owned-builder-mode").unwrap();
            fs::write("owned-builder-ready", std::process::id().to_string()).unwrap();
            match mode.as_str() {
                "generation" | "rebuild" => {
                    thread::sleep(Duration::from_secs(3));
                    fs::write("owned-builder-completed", b"unexpected completion").unwrap();
                }
                "success" => println!("owned builder success"),
                "failure" => {
                    eprintln!("owned builder failure detail");
                    std::process::exit(23);
                }
                "flood-failure" | "same-stream-flood" | "clip-failure" => {
                    let block = [b'x'; 8192];
                    let blocks = if mode == "clip-failure" { 10 } else { 320 };
                    for _ in 0..blocks { io::stdout().write_all(&block).unwrap(); }
                    if mode == "same-stream-flood" {
                        println!("owned late stdout failure omitted by bounded capture");
                    } else { eprintln!("owned stderr after verbose stdout"); }
                    std::process::exit(23);
                }
                _ => panic!("unknown owned builder mode"),
            }
        }
        Some("--psx-builder-contract") => {
            // Independent SDK refusal rule: generation must never enable acquisition.
            assert!(args.iter().any(|argument| argument == "--no-toolchain-download"));
            if args.iter().any(|argument| argument == "rebuild") {
                for launcher in ["C", "CXX"] {
                    let expected = format!("--cmake-extra=-DCMAKE_{launcher}_COMPILER_LAUNCHER:STRING=");
                    assert_eq!(args.iter().filter(|argument| **argument == expected).count(), 1);
                }
                assert_eq!(args.iter().filter(|argument| argument.starts_with("--cmake-extra")).count(), 2);
                assert!(args.iter().any(|argument| argument == "--no-pgo"));
                assert!(args.windows(2).any(|pair| pair == ["--target", "psx-runtime"]));
                assert!(args.windows(2).any(|pair| pair == ["--prune-after", "build-intermediates"]));
            }
            let root = env::current_dir().unwrap();
            let private = root.join(".portcove-builder-environment");
            let python = env::current_exe().unwrap();
            assert_eq!(env::split_paths(&env::var_os("PATH").unwrap()).collect::<Vec<_>>(),
                vec![root.join("bin"), python.parent().unwrap().to_path_buf()]);
            for name in ["HOME", "USERPROFILE", "APPDATA", "LOCALAPPDATA", "XDG_CACHE_HOME",
                         "XDG_DATA_HOME", "XDG_CONFIG_HOME", "RETCOMM_TOOLCHAIN_CACHE",
                         "RETCOMM_DATA_HOME", "TEMP", "TMP", "TMPDIR"] {
                assert!(std::path::PathBuf::from(env::var_os(name).unwrap()).starts_with(&private));
            }
            for name in ["GH_TOKEN", "GITHUB_TOKEN", "PORTCOVE_GITHUB_TOKEN",
                         "LD_LIBRARY_PATH", "DYLD_LIBRARY_PATH", "HOMEDRIVE", "HOMEPATH"] {
                assert!(env::var_os(name).is_none());
            }
            // Keep this inert tool alive through the supervisor's membership
            // observations. An instant child can correctly leave a lifetime gap.
            assert!(Command::new("cmake").arg("--sleep").status().unwrap().success());
            for name in ["HOME", "TEMP"] {
                fs::write(std::path::PathBuf::from(env::var_os(name).unwrap()).join("builder-probe"), b"private fixture write").unwrap();
            }
        }
        Some("--game") if args.iter().any(|argument| argument == "--extract") => owned_preparation(&args),
        Some("--game") => {
            if let Some(pair) = args.windows(2).find(|pair| pair[0] == "--owned-wait") {
                let deadline = std::time::Instant::now() + Duration::from_secs(10);
                while !std::path::Path::new(&pair[1]).exists() {
                    if std::time::Instant::now() >= deadline { std::process::exit(8); }
                    thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(20));
                }
            }
            println!("owned game launched");
        },
        Some("-help") => {
            println!("chdman verify extractdvd");
            std::process::exit(1);
        }
        Some("--success") => println!("testtool verify convert"),
        Some("--nonzero") => std::process::exit(7),
        Some("--sleep") => {
            thread::sleep(Duration::from_secs(2));
            println!("testtool verify convert");
        }
        Some("--large") => print!("testtool verify convert {}", "x".repeat(8192)),
        Some("--malformed") => io::stdout().write_all(&[0xff, 0xfe]).unwrap(),
        Some("--incompatible") => println!("testtool legacy"),
        Some("--record") => {
            fs::write(&args[1], args[2..].join("\n")).unwrap();
            println!("testtool verify convert");
        }
        Some("--tree") => {
            let child = Command::new(env::current_exe().unwrap())
                .args(["--grandchild", &args[1]])
                .spawn()
                .unwrap();
            let marker = std::path::Path::new(&args[1]);
            fs::write(marker.with_extension("pids"), format!("{}\n{}", std::process::id(), child.id())).unwrap();
            fs::write(marker.with_extension("ready"), b"root and descendant started").unwrap();
            thread::sleep(Duration::from_secs(2));
        }
        Some("--closure-fanout") => {
            // Fixed first-party process workload; no shell, game or network.
            fs::write("closure-root-pid", std::process::id().to_string()).unwrap();
            let mut children = Vec::new();
            for index in 0..34 {
                children.push(Command::new(env::current_exe().unwrap())
                    .args(["--closure-fanout-child", &index.to_string()])
                    .spawn().unwrap());
            }
            fs::write("closure-child-pids", children.iter().map(|c| c.id().to_string()).collect::<Vec<_>>().join("\n")).unwrap();
            let deadline = std::time::Instant::now() + Duration::from_secs(30);
            while !std::path::Path::new("closure-release").is_file() {
                if std::time::Instant::now() >= deadline { std::process::exit(8); }
                thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(1));
            }
            // Root and descendants race to exit; deliberately do not wait here.
        }
        Some("--closure-fanout-child") => {
            let index: usize = args[1].parse().unwrap();
            assert!(index < 34);
            fs::write(format!("closure-child-ready-{index}"), std::process::id().to_string()).unwrap();
            let deadline = std::time::Instant::now() + Duration::from_secs(30);
            while !std::path::Path::new("closure-release").is_file() {
                if std::time::Instant::now() >= deadline { std::process::exit(8); }
                thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(1));
            }
        }
        Some("--setup-tree") => {
            let observed = args.get(2).is_some_and(|arg| arg.starts_with("observed-"));
            let mut command = Command::new(env::current_exe().unwrap());
            if observed {
                command.args(["--grandchild-held", &args[1], "descendant-release"]);
            } else {
                command.args(["--grandchild", &args[1]]);
            }
            let child = command.spawn().unwrap();
            fs::write("descendant-pid", child.id().to_string()).unwrap();
            if observed {
                let deadline = std::time::Instant::now() + Duration::from_secs(5);
                while !std::path::Path::new("descendant-observed").is_file() {
                    if std::time::Instant::now() >= deadline { std::process::exit(9); }
                    thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(10));
                }
            }
            if args.get(2).is_some_and(|arg| arg == "wait" || arg == "observed-wait") {
                thread::sleep(Duration::from_secs(8));
            }
            if observed {
                fs::write("leader-exiting", b"exiting").unwrap();
            }
        }
        Some("--setup-unobserved-child" | "--setup-unobserved-image" | "--setup-console-image") => {
            #[cfg(windows)]
            let console=if args[0]=="--setup-console-image" {Some(console_fixture::Session::allocate().unwrap())} else {None};
            fs::write("leader-ready", b"ready").unwrap();
            let deadline = std::time::Instant::now() + Duration::from_secs(5);
            while !std::path::Path::new("spawn-child").is_file() {
                if std::time::Instant::now() >= deadline { std::process::exit(9); }
                thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(10));
            }
            let mut child = if args[0] == "--setup-unobserved-image" || args[0]=="--setup-console-image" {
                // run_setup appends its admitted source after explicit arguments.
                assert_eq!(args.len(), 3);
                assert!(std::path::Path::new(&args[2]).is_absolute());
                let image = std::path::Path::new(&args[1]);
                assert!(image.is_absolute() && image.is_file());
                let mut command = Command::new(image);
                let test=if args[0]=="--setup-console-image" {"tool_process::tests::console_image_fixture_child"} else {"tool_process::tests::different_image_fixture_child"};
                command.args([test, "--exact", "--ignored", "--test-threads=1"]);
                command
            } else {
                let mut command = Command::new(env::current_exe().unwrap());
                command.arg("--success");
                command
            };
            let status = child.status().unwrap();
            assert!(status.success());
            #[cfg(windows)]
            if let Some(console)=console {console.finish().unwrap();}
            fs::write("child-finished", b"exited before the next membership snapshot").unwrap();
        }
        #[cfg(unix)]
        Some("--setup-tree-escape") => {
            let child = Command::new(env::current_exe().unwrap())
                .args(["--escaped-grandchild", &args[1], &args[2]])
                .stdin(Stdio::null())
                .stdout(Stdio::null())
                .stderr(Stdio::null())
                .spawn()
                .unwrap();
            fs::write("descendant-pid", child.id().to_string()).unwrap();
            let deadline = std::time::Instant::now() + Duration::from_secs(5);
            while !std::path::Path::new(&args[2]).is_file() {
                if std::time::Instant::now() >= deadline {
                    std::process::exit(9);
                }
                thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(10));
            }
        }
        #[cfg(unix)]
        Some("--escaped-grandchild") => {
            unsafe extern "C" {
                fn setsid() -> i32;
            }
            assert_ne!(unsafe { setsid() }, -1);
            fs::write(&args[2], b"detached").unwrap();
            thread::sleep(Duration::from_secs(1));
            fs::write(&args[1], b"escaped").unwrap();
        }
        Some("--grandchild") => {
            thread::sleep(Duration::from_secs(1));
            fs::write(&args[1], b"orphaned").unwrap();
        }
        Some("--grandchild-held") => {
            let deadline = std::time::Instant::now() + Duration::from_secs(8);
            while !std::path::Path::new(&args[2]).is_file() {
                if std::time::Instant::now() >= deadline { std::process::exit(8); }
                thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(10));
            }
            fs::write(&args[1], b"orphaned").unwrap();
        }
        _ => println!("wrong program"),
    }
}

#[cfg(windows)]
mod console_fixture {
    use std::{ffi::c_void, fs, io, os::windows::io::{FromRawHandle, IntoRawHandle, OwnedHandle}};
    #[repr(C)] struct Options {mode:i32,use_show:i32,show:u16}
    #[link(name="kernel32")] unsafe extern "system" {
        fn GetModuleHandleW(name:*const u16)->*mut c_void;
        fn GetProcAddress(module:*mut c_void,name:*const core::ffi::c_char)->*mut c_void;
        fn GetCurrentProcess()->*mut c_void;
        fn DuplicateHandle(source_process:*mut c_void,source:*mut c_void,target_process:*mut c_void,target:*mut *mut c_void,access:u32,inherit:i32,options:u32)->i32;
        fn GetStdHandle(which:u32)->*mut c_void;
        fn SetStdHandle(which:u32,handle:*mut c_void)->i32;
        fn FreeConsole()->i32;
        fn GetConsoleProcessList(pids:*mut u32,count:u32)->u32;
        fn GetConsoleWindow()->*mut c_void;
    }
    #[link(name="user32")] unsafe extern "system" {fn GetWindowThreadProcessId(window:*mut c_void,pid:*mut u32)->u32;}
    pub struct Session {attached:bool}
    impl Drop for Session {fn drop(&mut self){if self.attached {unsafe{FreeConsole()};}}}
    impl Session {
        pub fn allocate()->io::Result<Self> {
            let name="kernel32.dll\0".encode_utf16().collect::<Vec<_>>();
            let module=unsafe{GetModuleHandleW(name.as_ptr())};
            if module.is_null(){return Err(io::Error::last_os_error());}
            let function=unsafe{GetProcAddress(module,c"AllocConsoleWithOptions".as_ptr())};
            if function.is_null(){return Err(io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::Unsupported,"owned hidden console API unavailable"));}
            let allocate:unsafe extern "system" fn(*const Options,*mut i32)->i32=unsafe{std::mem::transmute(function)};
            // Preserve each owned standard stream before allocation replaces it.
            // Duplicates are transferred to process standard-handle ownership;
            // kernel teardown at the positively waited process exit closes them.
            let mut streams=Vec::new();
            for which in [-10i32,-11,-12] {
                let handle=unsafe{GetStdHandle(which as u32)};
                if handle.is_null() || handle as isize == -1 {return Err(io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::InvalidInput,"owned standard handle absent"));}
                let mut copy=std::ptr::null_mut();let process=unsafe{GetCurrentProcess()};
                if unsafe{DuplicateHandle(process,handle,process,&mut copy,0,0,2)}==0 {return Err(io::Error::last_os_error());}
                streams.push((which as u32,unsafe{OwnedHandle::from_raw_handle(copy)}));
            }
            unsafe{FreeConsole()}; // Detach only this process, never another client.
            let mut ids=[0u32;8];
            if unsafe{GetConsoleProcessList(ids.as_mut_ptr(),8)}!=0 {return Err(io::Error::other("old console remains attached"));}
            let options=Options{mode:1,use_show:1,show:0};let mut result=0;
            let status=unsafe{allocate(&options,&mut result)};
            if status!=0 || result!=1 {return Err(io::Error::other(format!("owned console allocation refused: {status}/{result}")));}
            let session=Self{attached:true};
            for (which,handle) in streams {
                use std::os::windows::io::AsRawHandle;
                if unsafe{SetStdHandle(which,handle.as_raw_handle())}==0 {return Err(io::Error::last_os_error());}
                let _=handle.into_raw_handle();
            }
            let count=unsafe{GetConsoleProcessList(ids.as_mut_ptr(),8)};
            if count!=1 || ids[0]!=std::process::id() {return Err(io::Error::other("new console is not private to the owned root"));}
            fs::write("console-root-pid",ids[0].to_string())?;
            let window=unsafe{GetConsoleWindow()};let mut host=0;
            if window.is_null() || unsafe{GetWindowThreadProcessId(window,&mut host)}==0 || host==0 {return Err(io::Error::other("owned console host window identity unavailable"));}
            // Window owner is diagnostic only; it need not be the console host.
            fs::write("console-window-owner-pid",host.to_string())?;
            fs::write("console-session-ready",b"actual new hidden console; owned root only")?;
            Ok(session)
        }
        pub fn finish(mut self)->io::Result<()> {
            let mut ids=[0u32;8];
            let count=unsafe{GetConsoleProcessList(ids.as_mut_ptr(),8)};
            if count!=1 || ids[0]!=std::process::id() {return Err(io::Error::other("console child did not detach before caller resumed"));}
            if unsafe{FreeConsole()}==0 {return Err(io::Error::last_os_error());}
            self.attached=false;
            if unsafe{GetConsoleProcessList(ids.as_mut_ptr(),8)}!=0 {return Err(io::Error::other("owned console remains after detach"));}
            fs::write("console-session-detached",b"last owned client detached")?;
            Ok(())
        }
    }
}

#[cfg(windows)]
mod exception_fixture {
    use super::fs;
    use std::{ffi::c_void, sync::atomic::{AtomicU32, Ordering}};
    #[repr(C)] struct ExceptionRecord { code:u32, flags:u32, nested:*mut c_void, address:*const u8 }
    #[repr(C,align(16))] struct ContextPrefix {
        home:[u64;6], flags:u32, mxcsr:u32, segments:[u16;6], eflags:u32,
        debug:[u64;6], registers:[u64;16], rip:u64,
    }
    const _:()=assert!(std::mem::offset_of!(ContextPrefix,rip)==248);
    #[repr(C)] struct ExceptionPointers { record:*const ExceptionRecord, context:*mut ContextPrefix }
    static HANDLED:AtomicU32=AtomicU32::new(0);
    static TLS_PHASE:AtomicU32=AtomicU32::new(0);
    unsafe extern "system" fn handler(info:*mut ExceptionPointers)->i32 {
        if info.is_null() || unsafe{(*info).record.is_null()} { return 0; }
        let code=unsafe{(*(*info).record).code};
        if code==0x8000_0003 {
            let context=unsafe{(*info).context};
            if context.is_null() || unsafe{(*context).flags}&0x0010_0001!=0x0010_0001 { return 0; }
            let address=unsafe{(*(*info).record).address};
            let mut instruction=0u8; let mut read=0usize;
            if unsafe{ReadProcessMemory(GetCurrentProcess(),address.cast(),(&raw mut instruction).cast(),1,&raw mut read)}==0 || read!=1 || instruction!=0xcc { return 0; }
            let at=address as u64;
            let Some(after)=at.checked_add(1) else { return 0; };
            let rip=unsafe{(*context).rip};
            if rip==at { unsafe{(*context).rip=after}; }
            else if rip!=after { return 0; }
        }
        if code==0xe042_3333 || code==0xe042_5555 || code==0x8000_0003 {
            HANDLED.fetch_add(1,Ordering::Relaxed);
            -1 // EXCEPTION_CONTINUE_EXECUTION; application handler owns this.
        } else { 0 } // EXCEPTION_CONTINUE_SEARCH; never swallow terminal exception.
    }
    #[link(name="kernel32")] unsafe extern "system" {
        fn AddVectoredExceptionHandler(first:u32,handler:unsafe extern "system" fn(*mut ExceptionPointers)->i32)->*mut c_void;
        fn RemoveVectoredExceptionHandler(handle:*mut c_void)->u32;
        fn RaiseException(code:u32,flags:u32,count:u32,args:*const usize);
        fn DebugBreak();
        fn SetErrorMode(mode:u32)->u32;
        fn WerSetFlags(flags:u32)->i32;
        fn GetCurrentProcess()->*mut c_void;
        fn ReadProcessMemory(process:*mut c_void,address:*const c_void,buffer:*mut c_void,size:usize,read:*mut usize)->i32;
    }
    pub fn run(mode: &str) {
    assert!(cfg!(target_arch="x86_64"));
    assert!(mode=="handled" || mode=="unhandled");
    unsafe { SetErrorMode(0x0001|0x0002); } // No critical-error or fault dialog.
    assert!(unsafe{WerSetFlags(0x20)}>=0); // Current-process WER_FAULT_REPORTING_NO_UI.
    let handle=unsafe{AddVectoredExceptionHandler(1,handler)};
    assert!(!handle.is_null());
    if mode=="handled" {
        unsafe { RaiseException(0xe042_3333,0,0,std::ptr::null()); DebugBreak(); DebugBreak(); }
        assert_eq!(HANDLED.load(Ordering::Relaxed),3);
        fs::write("application-exceptions-handled",b"custom exception and two DebugBreak calls").unwrap();
        assert_ne!(unsafe{RemoveVectoredExceptionHandler(handle)},0);
    } else {
        fs::write("application-unhandled-ready",b"second-chance refusal required").unwrap();
        unsafe { RaiseException(0xe042_4444,0,0,std::ptr::null()); }
        panic!("unhandled exception was swallowed");
    }
}

    pub fn verify_tls() {
        assert_eq!(TLS_PHASE.load(Ordering::Acquire),2,"PE TLS callback did not complete");
        assert_eq!(HANDLED.load(Ordering::Relaxed),2,"TLS exception was substituted or swallowed");
        fs::write("tls-exceptions-handled",b"custom exception and DebugBreak handled inside TLS callback").unwrap();
    }
    pub fn verify_dll(path:&str) {
        use std::os::windows::ffi::OsStrExt;
        assert!(cfg!(target_arch="x86_64"));
        assert!(std::path::Path::new(path).is_absolute() && std::path::Path::new(path).is_file());
        let mut wide=std::ffi::OsStr::new(path).encode_wide().collect::<Vec<_>>();
        assert!(!wide.contains(&0));wide.push(0);
        unsafe{SetErrorMode(1|2);}
        assert!(unsafe{WerSetFlags(0x20)}>=0);
        let module=unsafe{LoadLibraryExW(wide.as_ptr(),std::ptr::null_mut(),0x100|0x800)};
        assert!(!module.is_null(),"owned DLL entry failed");
        let getter=unsafe{GetProcAddress(module,c"owned_dll_receipt".as_ptr())};
        assert!(!getter.is_null(),"owned DLL receipt export missing");
        let receipt:unsafe extern "system" fn()->u32=unsafe{std::mem::transmute(getter)};
        assert_eq!(unsafe{receipt()},0x0002_0002,"DLL entry handlers did not complete");
        assert_ne!(unsafe{FreeLibrary(module)},0);
        fs::write("dll-exceptions-handled",b"owned DLL entry phase2 counted two handled exceptions").unwrap();
    }
    #[link(name="kernel32")] unsafe extern "system" {
        fn GetCommandLineW()->*const u16;
        fn ExitProcess(code:u32)->!;
        fn LoadLibraryExW(path:*const u16,file:*mut c_void,flags:u32)->*mut c_void;
        fn GetProcAddress(module:*mut c_void,name:*const core::ffi::c_char)->*mut c_void;
        fn FreeLibrary(module:*mut c_void)->i32;
    }
    unsafe extern "system" fn tls_handler(info:*mut ExceptionPointers)->i32 {
        if TLS_PHASE.load(Ordering::Acquire)!=1 || info.is_null() || unsafe{(*info).record.is_null()} {return 0;}
        let code=unsafe{(*(*info).record).code};
        if code!=0xe042_5555 && code!=0x8000_0003 {return 0;}
        unsafe{handler(info)}
    }
    unsafe extern "system" fn tls_callback(_: *mut c_void,reason:u32,_:*mut c_void) {
        if reason!=1 || !cfg!(target_arch="x86_64") {return;}
        let command=unsafe{GetCommandLineW()};
        if command.is_null() {return;}
        let mut len=0usize;
        while len<32768 && unsafe{*command.add(len)}!=0 {len+=1;}
        if len>=32768 {return;}
        // Only the exact owned flag at the command-line suffix admits this hook.
        const SUFFIX:&[u16]=&[32,34,45,45,111,119,110,101,100,45,116,108,115,45,101,120,99,101,112,116,105,111,110,115,34];
        if len<SUFFIX.len() {return;}
        if unsafe{std::slice::from_raw_parts(command.add(len-SUFFIX.len()),SUFFIX.len())}!=SUFFIX {return;}
        unsafe{SetErrorMode(1|2);}
        TLS_PHASE.store(1,Ordering::Release);
        let handle=unsafe{AddVectoredExceptionHandler(1,tls_handler)};
        if handle.is_null() {unsafe{ExitProcess(31)}}
        unsafe{RaiseException(0xe042_5555,0,0,std::ptr::null());}
        if HANDLED.load(Ordering::Relaxed)!=1 {unsafe{ExitProcess(32)}}
        unsafe{DebugBreak();}
        if HANDLED.load(Ordering::Relaxed)!=2 {unsafe{ExitProcess(33)}}
        if unsafe{RemoveVectoredExceptionHandler(handle)}==0 {unsafe{ExitProcess(34)}}
        TLS_PHASE.store(2,Ordering::Release);
    }
    #[used]
    #[unsafe(link_section=".CRT$XLB")]
    static TLS_CALLBACK:unsafe extern "system" fn(*mut c_void,u32,*mut c_void)=tls_callback;
}
fn owned_preparation(args: &[String]) {
    let game = args.windows(2).find(|pair| pair[0] == "--game").map(|pair| pair[1].as_str()).unwrap_or("jak1");
    assert!(["jak1", "jak2", "jak3"].contains(&game));
    let mode = if args.iter().any(|arg| arg == "--owned-fixture-mode") {
        let positions = args.iter().enumerate().filter(|(_, arg)| *arg == "--owned-fixture-mode").map(|(index, _)| index).collect::<Vec<_>>();
        assert_eq!(positions.len(), 1, "duplicate owned fixture mode");
        let mode = args.get(positions[0] + 1).expect("missing owned fixture mode");
        assert!(["success", "missing-marker", "unowned-output", "save-change", "executable-change", "failure", "wait"].contains(&mode.as_str()), "unknown owned fixture mode");
        mode.clone()
    } else {
        let Ok(mode) = fs::read_to_string("owned-setup-mode") else {
            return;
        };
        mode
    };
    println!("owned setup began token=owned-fixture-private-value");
    eprintln!("owned setup diagnostic on stderr");
    fs::create_dir_all(format!("data/out/{game}/iso")).unwrap();
    if mode == "missing-marker" {
        return;
    }
    fs::write(format!("data/out/{game}/iso/0COMMON.TXT"), b"owned validated output").unwrap();
    fs::create_dir_all("data/log").unwrap();
    fs::write("data/log/setup.log", b"disposable diagnostic").unwrap();
    match mode.as_str() {
        "success" => {}
        "unowned-output" => fs::write("unexpected-output", b"outside contract").unwrap(),
        "save-change" => fs::write(format!("OpenGOAL/{game}/save.bin"), b"bad save change").unwrap(),
        "executable-change" => fs::write(
            if cfg!(windows) { "gk.exe" } else { "gk" },
            b"bad executable change",
        )
        .unwrap(),
        "failure" => std::process::exit(23),
        "wait" => {
            fs::write("data/out/setup-ready", b"ready").unwrap();
            std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_secs(30));
        }
        _ => panic!("unknown owned fixture mode"),
    }
}

fn owned_conversion(args: &[String]) {
    let source = std::path::Path::new(args.windows(2).find(|pair| pair[0] == "-i").unwrap()[1].as_str());
    let destination = std::path::Path::new(args.windows(2).find(|pair| pair[0] == "-o").unwrap()[1].as_str());
    let mode = fs::read_to_string(source.with_extension("conversion-mode")).unwrap_or_else(|_| "success".into());
    println!("owned conversion began password=owned-conversion-secret");
    eprintln!("owned conversion diagnostic on stderr");
    fs::write(destination, b"owned converted ISO").unwrap();
    fs::write(source.with_extension("conversion-pid"), std::process::id().to_string()).unwrap();
    match mode.as_str() {
        "success" => {},
        "failure" => std::process::exit(29),
        "wait" => {
            let child = Command::new(env::current_exe().unwrap()).args(["--grandchild", source.with_extension("orphan-output").to_str().unwrap()]).spawn().unwrap();
            fs::write(source.with_extension("conversion-child-pid"), child.id().to_string()).unwrap();
            thread::sleep(Duration::from_secs(8));
            fs::write(source.with_extension("conversion-unexpected-completion"), b"unexpected").unwrap();
        },
        _ => panic!("unknown conversion fixture mode"),
    }
}

fn owned_psx_conversion(args: &[String]) {
    let source = std::path::Path::new(args.windows(2).find(|pair| pair[0] == "-i").unwrap()[1].as_str());
    let cue = std::path::Path::new(args.windows(2).find(|pair| pair[0] == "-o").unwrap()[1].as_str());
    let bins = args.windows(2).find(|pair| pair[0] == "-ob").unwrap()[1].replace("%t", "1");
    fs::write(cue, b"FILE \"disc1.bin\" BINARY\n  TRACK 01 MODE2/2352\n    INDEX 01 00:00:00\n").unwrap();
    fs::write(bins, b"owned psx track").unwrap();
    let mode = fs::read_to_string(source.with_extension("conversion-mode")).unwrap_or_else(|_| "success".into());
    match mode.as_str() {
        "success" => {},
        "failure" => std::process::exit(29),
        "wait" | "inspection-held" => {
            let child = Command::new(env::current_exe().unwrap()).args(["--grandchild-held", source.with_extension("orphan-output").to_str().unwrap(), source.with_extension("conversion-release").to_str().unwrap()]).spawn().unwrap();
            fs::write(source.with_extension("conversion-child-pid"), child.id().to_string()).unwrap();
            fs::write(source.with_extension("conversion-ready"), b"owned helper and descendant started").unwrap();
            if mode == "inspection-held" {
                let deadline = std::time::Instant::now() + Duration::from_secs(5);
                while !source.with_extension("conversion-release").is_file() {
                    assert!(std::time::Instant::now() < deadline, "owned inspection release did not arrive");
                    thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(10));
                }
            } else {
                thread::sleep(Duration::from_secs(8));
            }
            fs::write(source.with_extension("conversion-unexpected-completion"), b"unexpected").unwrap();
        },
        _ => panic!("unknown owned PSX conversion mode"),
    }
}
